what_works: Heritage range labels ('Estate', 'St. Andrews') get dedicated editorial sections with multi-generational copy threaded through. Gold-on-cream accents do the 'family since...' work without screaming.
what_does_not_translate: E-commerce mega-menu density is overkill for a service contractor — borrow the section copy patterns, not the nav.
type_observations: Sans-serif body with serif/italic accent for heritage callouts — the italic does the 'three generations' lifting.
